# Sephora
> Sephora is a beauty retailer offering makeup, skincare, fragrance, hair, bath, and wellness products from prestige brands.

Sephora.com combines product discovery, brand storefronts, editorial guidance, loyalty benefits, and omnichannel shopping services including same-day delivery, buy online pickup, and store services.

## Core Shopping Categories
- [Makeup](https://www.sephora.com/shop/makeup-cosmetics): Shop foundation, lipstick, mascara, palettes, tools, and makeup sets across prestige brands.
- [Skincare](https://www.sephora.com/shop/skincare): Browse cleansers, moisturizers, serums, masks, sunscreens, and targeted skincare treatments.
- [Hair](https://www.sephora.com/shop/hair-products): Explore shampoos, conditioners, styling products, treatments, and hair tools.
- [Fragrance](https://www.sephora.com/shop/fragrance): Discover perfumes, colognes, fragrance sets, candles, and home scent products.
- [Bath & Body](https://www.sephora.com/shop/bath-body): Shop body washes, lotions, scrubs, deodorants, and body care essentials.
- [Tools & Brushes](https://www.sephora.com/shop/makeup-brushes-tools): Find makeup brushes, applicators, mirrors, sharpeners, and beauty tools.
- [Beauty Supplements](https://www.sephora.com/shop/beauty-supplements): Browse ingestible wellness and beauty supplements for skin, hair, and overall health.

## Featured Shopping Paths
- [New Arrivals](https://www.sephora.com/shop/new-beauty-products): See the latest product launches and newly added beauty products.
- [Bestsellers](https://www.sephora.com/shop/best-selling-beauty-products): Explore Sephora’s most popular and top-rated beauty products.
- [Value & Gift Sets](https://www.sephora.com/shop/value-gift-sets): Shop curated beauty sets, discovery kits, and value bundles.
- [Mini Size](https://www.sephora.com/shop/mini-size-products): Find travel-friendly and trial-size beauty products across categories.
- [Clean at Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/shop/clean-beauty-products): Browse products formulated without specified ingredients under Sephora’s clean standard.
- [Vegan](https://www.sephora.com/shop/vegan-beauty-products): Shop vegan beauty products across makeup, skincare, hair, and fragrance.
- [Sale](https://www.sephora.com/shop/sale): View discounted beauty products and limited-time markdowns.

## Brands
- [Brands A-Z](https://www.sephora.com/brands-list): Browse all beauty brands carried by Sephora in alphabetical order.
- [Sephora Collection](https://www.sephora.com/brand/sephora-collection): Shop Sephora’s in-house makeup, skincare, tools, and accessories.
- [The Ordinary](https://www.sephora.com/brand/the-ordinary): Explore targeted skincare and treatment products from The Ordinary.
- [Drunk Elephant](https://www.sephora.com/brand/drunk-elephant): Browse skincare, body care, and treatment products from Drunk Elephant.
- [Rare Beauty by Selena Gomez](https://www.sephora.com/brand/rare-beauty-by-selena-gomez): Shop makeup and beauty products from Rare Beauty.
- [Dior](https://www.sephora.com/brand/dior): Discover Dior makeup, fragrance, and skincare products.
- [Charlotte Tilbury](https://www.sephora.com/brand/charlotte-tilbury): Browse makeup, skincare, and complexion products from Charlotte Tilbury.

## Gifts and Discovery
- [Gifts](https://www.sephora.com/shop/gifts): Shop beauty gifts by category, occasion, and recipient.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/giftcards): Purchase physical and electronic Sephora gift cards.
- [Perfume Gift Sets](https://www.sephora.com/shop/perfume-gift-sets): Browse fragrance gift sets and perfume sampler options.
- [Skincare Value Sets](https://www.sephora.com/shop/skincare-value-sets): Discover bundled skincare kits and regimen-focused sets.
- [Makeup Value Sets](https://www.sephora.com/shop/makeup-value-sets): Shop makeup gift sets and curated cosmetics collections.
- [Fragrance Samplers](https://www.sephora.com/shop/perfume-sampler): Explore fragrance sampler sets for scent discovery.
